I submitted the pizza order, and httpbin's response echoed back every field as entered:

- **Customer name:** Ada Lovelace
- **Telephone:** 555-0100
- **Email:** ada@example.com
- **Size:** Large
- **Toppings:** Bacon and Extra Cheese
- **Delivery time:** 19:45
- **Delivery instructions:** Ring twice

The response page (`https://httpbin.org/post`) is still open in the browser tab.

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); agent-browser --session $S open https://httpbin.org/forms/post; agent-browser --session $S snapshot -i

B="agent-browser --session task-a99f5c34f1b5"; $B fill @e2 "Ada Lovelace"; $B fill @e3 "555-0100"; $B fill @e4 "ada@example.com"; $B check @e7; $B check @e8; $B check @e9; $B fill @e12 "Ring twice"; $B click @e14; $B type @e14 "07"; $B type @e15 "45"; $B type @e16 "PM"; $B eval "document.querySelector('input[name=delivery]').value"
